item.title: Augusta man dies after moped crash during sheriff’s office pursuit
item.description: A 53-year-old Augusta man died Tuesday after the moped he was driving crashed into a vacant building on Gordon Highway while being pursued by the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office, according to the Coroner’s Office. The post Augusta man dies after moped crash during sheriff’s office pursuit appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Food Lion feeds charitable foundation awards grant to United Way of the CSRA
item.description: United Way of the CSRA has received a $4,300 grant from the Food Lion Feeds Charitable Foundation to help expand access to nutritious food and provide nutrition education for neighbors experiencing food insecurity. The post Food Lion feeds charitable foundation awards grant to United Way of the CSRA appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Five RCSS schools exit state improvement list for students with disabilities
item.description: Five Richmond County School System schools exited the Georgia Department of Education’s Targeted Support and Improvement list this year for the subgroup of students with disabilities. The post Five RCSS schools exit state improvement list for students with disabilities appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Richmond County school board reviews safety, finances and facilities plans
item.description: The Richmond County Board of Education held its committee meeting ahead of its regular board meeting Tuesday, reviewing district finances, facilities projects, and school safety initiatives before recognizing students and staff later in the evening. The post Richmond County school board reviews safety, finances and facilities plans appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: The Columbia County Board of Commissioners approved a resolution asking the local legislative delegation to sponsor legislation regarding homestead tax relief grants. item.title: Augusta approves no-tax-increase budget using one-time funds, deep cuts
item.description: The Augusta Commission approved a balanced 2026 budget without a property tax increase, relying instead on one-time funding transfers and deep cuts to city departments and non-government organizations. item.description: Authorities say a coordinated gang enforcement operation led to multiple arrests, the seizure of large amounts of drugs and cash, and the takedown of a suspected gang leader tied to criminal activity across Augusta and Grovetown. item.title: Aviation Commission to assign StandardAero property to Augusta Development Authority
item.description: The Augusta Aviation Commission approved assigning the Hangar Road property where the expanded StandardAero maintenance facility is located to the Augusta Economic Development Authority (AEDA), during a special called meeting Wednesday morning.
